title: Black Clover Season 2 Shocks With Sudden Love Confession
content:
Black Clover is reaching the final stretch of its episodes for Season 2 this year, but the latest episode really took fans by surprise with a sudden confession of love. Black Clover Season 2 has been working its way through the adaptation of the Spade Kingdom Raid arc from Yuki Tabata’s original manga, and each new episodes brings the fights against the Dark Triad one step closer to their end. And the latest episode explored the fallout of the fight against Megicula we had seen before .

Black Clover Season 2 recently wrapped up the fight with Megicula, and it came with some major developments for Noelle Silva during the midst of it. The fight saw her realizing that she really has romantic feelings for Asta for the first real time , but the newest episode threw even her for a loop as another relationship is developing instead between Lolopechka and Gaja thanks to his sudden confession of love.

Black Clover Season 2 Confirms Lolopechka and Gaja Romance

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 8 explores the immediate fallout of the fight with Megicula. It had seemed like Gaja had fully sacrificed himself, but Mimosa Vermillion arrived just in time to heal his fatal injuries. With Lolopechka also being freed from the Supreme Devil’s curse, it was the first reunion between the two since they were last seen in the anime five years ago. Gaja had been fighting to rescue Lolopechka after she had been kidnapped from the Heart Kingdom, and wasted no time with her reunion with her at last.

Gaja fully confessed his feelings of love to Lolopechka, and it seems like the two of them are going to happily move forward with their new relationship. With how many of these types of romantic connections that have been seen in Black Clover so far, it makes a great deal of difference to see that a relationship is actually moving forward. It’s not just someone hiding their crush on someone else through wacky understandings, and hopefully it could inspire Noelle to move forward with her own crush.

What’s Next for Black Clover Season 2?

Black Clover Season 2 has yet to confirm how many episodes it’s going to be sticking around for, but it’s been made even more apparent with the latest episodes that it’s going to be wrapping up its run later this year. The season has already seen two members of the Dark Triad being defeated, and the next one is close at hand . There aren’t many fights left in the arc to explore from this point, so fans should get ready for the climax hitting sooner rather than later.

Black Clover is also leading towards its adaptation of the final arc from Yuki Tabata’s original manga sooner rather than later, but it’s likely going to be in a future season yet to come. But that’s all yet to be officially confirmed one way or the other, so it’s best to catch up with Season 2 now streaming with Crunchyroll to see what could be coming on the way next.

What did you think of Black Clover’ s latest confession in Season 2’s newest episode? How are you liking the new season so far? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Link Click Season 3 Confirms 2027 Return for Part 2 With New Look
content:
Link Click confirms a 2027 release window for Season 3 Part 2. Crunchyroll brought back the new season of this beloved series in August this year as part of the Summer 2026 anime lineup. As the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the globe, Crunchyroll is home to several acclaimed shows and movies, including Donghua, a term used for Chinese animation . The industry has been on the rise for the past few years, with Link Click being one of the most notable series thanks to its global availability on Crunchyroll. The donghua is based on an original story, and it centers around mind-bending mysteries while blending supernatural themes.

The story has always been kind of intense and heartbreaking, but things have taken a turn for the worse in the latest season. The first part of Season 3 reached its conclusion last weekend, and the anime confirmed the release window of Part 2 right away. Fans also got the first look at the second part and everything else we can expect from the story going forward. The official YouTube channel of Bilibili shared the second part’s trailer while the official X handle dropped a new key visual.

What Is the Release Date of Link Click Season 3 Part 2?

Link Click Season 3 Part 2 has confirmed a 2027 release window, and the anime is expected to premiere in the second half of next year. However, the exact release date won’t be announced anytime soon. Link Click doesn’t always follow the quarterly schedule on Crunchyroll, where all anime series are released around the first two weeks of the month after TV broadcast in Japan.

While most of the Summer anime are released in July, Link Click released its third season a month later, and it’s quite possible the anime will follow a similar schedule this time as well. Additionally, we can expect the anime to return on Crunchyroll, where you can also find all the episodes.

Link Click Season 3 Part 2 Will Be More Intense Than Ever

The trailer is more than enough to convince fans that the upcoming season will be more gruesome than ever, where Lu Guang will face a major threat to his life. The story doesn’t shy away from taking fans on an emotional rollercoaster with the dark themes and heart-wrenching tragedies, and the latest season has made it clear that things will only continue to get worse.

The key visual also highlights the true extent of the horrors that Xiaoshi and Guang will keep facing from here on out, as they stand in front of several corpses. Needless to say, the situation appears to be far worse than anything they both have ever faced so far. Additionally, we can also expect more plot twists in the upcoming episodes that will completely turn the lives of everyone in Time Studio upside down.

Are you caught up with all episodes of Link Click on Crunchyroll? Head down to the comments to let us know your expectations for Season 3 Part 2.

title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Anime Reveals New Trailer, Additional Cast, January 3 Premiere
content:
The Kept Man of the Princess Knight anime revealed a new trailer, additional cast and a January 3, 2027 premiere date. Additionally, sajou no hana sings the ending theme song “Gika.” The additional cast consists of:

• Yuya Hirose as Ralph

• Manaka Iwami as Noel

• Shion Wakayama as Beatrice

• Saori Onishi as Cecilia

Studio BLADE is animating with Chihiro Kumano as director. Deko Akao is writing the script while Hisao Ishii is designing the characters. The cast includes:

• Junichi Suwabe as Matthew

• Mikako Komatsu as Arwin

• Rie Takahashi as Vanessa

• Tetsu Inada as Dezu

• Rika Nagae as April

The Kept Man of the Princess Knight is a Japanese light novel series written by Toru Shirogane and illustrated by Saki Mashima. The series began publication under ASCII Media Works’ Dengeki Bunko imprint on February 10, 2022. There is also a manga adaptation by Keyyang, began serialization on Kadokawa’s ComicWalker manga website in September 2022. It got three volumes after which a sequel by Chihiro Yamazaki titled The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Act2 began on August 31, 2025. Yen Press is publishing the series in English, describing the light novel as: The Dungeon City is a wicked place filled with crime, debauchery, and death. Its one shining light is Arwin, the beautiful Crimson Princess Knight. She and her brave party of adventurers descend into the dungeon at the city’s center, seeking a legendary treasure with the power to rebuild the princess’s fallen kingdom. Many yearn to be by her side, but that spot is already taken by Matthew, a man despised by all in town as a cowardly weakling. Everyone thinks he is scum who just spends her hard-earned money on booze, women, and gambling. No one in the city—not even the princess knight— knows what Matthew is truly capable of. Source: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight anime Official Website ©Toru Shirogane, KADOKAWA / The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Production Committee

title: Kindergarten WARS Unveils New Visual and Trailer, Opening Theme Song Artist Ado
content:
Kindergarten WARS anime has unveiled the main visual and a new trailer on Wednesday. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Bibayatarametta” by Ado. The series debuts in April 2027.

Studio Sunrise and Felix Film are animating the series with Shinsuke Gomi as director. Junko Yamanaka is the character designer. The previously announced voice cast includes:

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Rita

• Kentaro Kumagai as Doug

• Hitomi Owada as Hana

• Satoshi Hino as Luke

• Mariya Ise as Silvia

• Romi Park as Erina

• Tetsu Inada as Gordon

• Mirei Kumagai as Mac

• Sumire Morohoshi as Una

You Chiba writes and draws the Kindergarten WARS manga, which began serialization on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ app and website in September 2022. It has released 15 volumes as of August 2025. Yen Press is releasing the manga in English, describing the story: Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she’s head-over-heels for good-looking men!

title: Demon Slayer Studio’s New Movie Confirms Return With New Sequel
content:
The newest movie from the studio behind the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba anime franchise has announced it’s now working on a new sequel to its latest release, Witch on the Holy Night. Studio Ufotable has been busy the last few years with all sorts of new projects now in various stages of development. But while fans are waiting on the next step in the Infinity Castle trilogy, the studio just hit theaters in Japan with their newest work adapting a major classic from TYPE-MOON’s library .

Studio Ufotable has had plenty of experience adapting TYPE-MOON’s various visual novel releases like the extended Fate/stay night franchise, and are currently making their way through theaters across Japan with a new feature film adaptation of Witch on the Holy Night. And to celebrate its current success in theaters in the region over its opening, it’s now been announced that Witch on the Holy Night has a new sequel film in the works too.

New Witch on the Holy Night Movie Sequel Announced

Witch on the Holy Night is currently working its way through theaters in Japan, and it’s doing quite well at the box office there so far. It’s earned a little over three million USD in its first weekend alone, and it’s been deemed a success by the studio as a result . Which also means they can now move forward on its sequel, but no release window or date has been announced for it at this time. That’s likely also further complicated with Ufotable’s ongoing work on the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle trilogy, which has yet to confirm a release either.

It won’t be too much longer before fans outside of Japan will be able to check it out for themselves as Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will be releasing the new film in the United States, Canada and more international territories on January 29th next yea r with both Japanese and English dubbed audio releases planned for the screenings. The English dub cast of the film has yet to be announced, but the Japanese voice cast from the original light novel are reprising their roles with Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki, Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji, and Yusuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Shizuki confirmed.

What to Know for Witch on the Holy Night

Directed by Masashi Takeuchi for Ufotable, Witch on the Holy Night is based off of the TYPE-MOON visual novel originally written by Kinoko Nasu . This is the same creator behind the Fate/stay night franchise , and this story takes place before much of the extended universe of Nasu’s other works so you won’t need to do too much homework before jumping into the new movie. It’s also going to feature the theme song titled “Yoru to Ao,” as performed by supercell with Moe Tsuzuki providing the character designs, Manabu Kamino handling the editing, and Hideyuki Fukasawa composing the music.

Studio Ufotable has had a ton of experience bringing TYPE-MOON’s various projects to life long before it even started the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba anime adaptation, and fans are now getting to see even more of their takes on it even with the success of its more blockbuster sibling. You might want to check this one out when it hits, but how do you feel about Witch on the Holy Night getting a sequel? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: New Shonen Jump Anime Confirms 2027 Release With First Look Trailer – Watch
content:
Another major series from Shueisha’s Shonen Jump library is making its official anime debut next year, and has dropped the first look at what to expect with its first full trailer. With 2027 fast approaching, it’s time to look ahead to all of the new Shonen Jump franchise releases we’ll see in the new year . This includes the titles from the digital Shonen Jump+ app, and Yu Chiba’s Kindergarten Wars has been one of the most promising yet. Now even more fans are going to get to see why.

Kindergarten Wars is a fun spy action series that sees dangerous assassins tasked with protecting children at a daycare, but they must keep it hidden from all of them at all times. It’s got the kind of look that makes it seem perfectly fitting for an anime adaptation , and now that’s even more true now seeing it in motion with a new trailer confirming an April 2027 launch for the new series. You can check out the trailer and poster for Kindergarten Wars below.

New Kindergarten Wars Anime Confirms Spring 2027 Release

Kindergarten Wars will be making its debut sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule , but no concrete release date or international release plans have been announced as of this time. Shinsuke Gomi will be directing the new anime for Sunrise and Felix Film with Junko Yamanaka providing the character designs, Takaomi Kanasaki providing the scripts, and Hiroshi Nakamura, Kenta Higashiohji, and Dai Haraguchi will be composing the music with Bandai Namco Filmworks overseeing the production.

Kindergarten Wars also confirms a voice cast including the likes of Atsumi Tanezaki as Rita, Kentaro Kumagai as Doug, Hitomi Ohwada as Hana, Satoshi Hino as Luke, Mariya Ise as Silvia, Romi Park as Erina, Tetsu Inada as Gordon, Mirei Kumagai as Mac, and Sumire Morohoshi as Una all revealed so far. It’s also been revealed that Ado will be performing the opening theme for the series titled “Bibayatarametta,” which can be heard in this new trailer as well.

What’s So Special About Kindergarten Wars ?

Kindergarten Wars has been a stand out hit for Shonen Jump+ ever since it made its debut in 2022, and the series has been working through the final arc of the series with its latest chapters. Series creator Yu Chiba officially confirmed that to be the case last year, but it’s yet to be revealed just how many more chapters are left given that the release schedule for the manga has been more relaxed through the past year as well. Either way, this new anime is about to introduce a lot more fans to the fold.

Kindergarten Wars has a blend of cute character art and designs with fun action, and that makes for a very interesting experience. Not only is it elevated with humor as a result of those designs, but the action takes a lot of fans by surprise too. If the anime can tap into that same balance of energy that the manga is able to dance around, it’s going to be a fun time. But how are you feeling about the Kindergarten Wars anime so far? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: Now That We Draw Anime Reveals New Trailer, Main Visual, Additional Cast, Ending Theme Song Artist
content:
Now That We Draw anime revealed a new trailer and a main visual. Additionally, Hina Youmiya joins the cast and Inner Journey sings “Serifu wa Iranai” for the ending theme song. The series is set to premiere on January 8, 2027, and it stars Sayumi Suzushiro stars as Niina Miyamoto and Ayumu Murase as Yuuki Uehara.

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( Blue Lock the Movie: Episode Nagi ) is directing the anime, with Deko Akao ( The Case Study of Vanitas ) in charge of the series composition and Hiromi Nakagawa ( Wataten! An Angel Flew Down to Me ) on character designs. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Kimiiro Hirari” by Shallm.

The anime is based on a manga by Kyu Takahata and Yuwji Kaba. It has been serialized in Hakusensha’s seinen manga magazine Young Animal since February 2023. Seven Seas Entertainment is publishing the manga in English, describing it as follows: Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break! Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten the similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them has any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

contentBlocks.text: Now That We Draw anime revealed a new trailer and a main visual. Additionally, Hina Youmiya joins the cast and Inner Journey sings “Serifu wa Iranai” for the ending theme song. The series is set to premiere on January 8, 2027, and it stars Sayumi Suzushiro stars as Niina Miyamoto and Ayumu Murase as Yuuki Uehara.

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( Blue Lock the Movie: Episode Nagi ) is directing the anime, with Deko Akao ( The Case Study of Vanitas ) in charge of the series composition and Hiromi Nakagawa ( Wataten! An Angel Flew Down to Me ) on character designs. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Kimiiro Hirari” by Shallm.

The anime is based on a manga by Kyu Takahata and Yuwji Kaba. It has been serialized in Hakusensha’s seinen manga magazine Young Animal since February 2023. Seven Seas Entertainment is publishing the manga in English, describing it as follows: Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break! Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten the similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them has any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

title: Ted: The Animated Series Reveals Big Returns With New Sneak Peek – Watch Now
content:
Ted is coming back with a brand new animated series hitting Peacock later this December, and a new sneak peek clip from Ted: The Animated Series is highlighting some big returns from the massively popular TV series. Ted has found new life through the success of its Peacock TV series , and now Seth MacFarlane’s universe is set to expand with a new animated series keeping the franchise going. But it’s taking things in a new direction that blends both the TV and movie releases.

Ted: The Animated Series picks up 12 years after the events of Ted 2 , and focuses on the older versions of John and Ted as the two of them now have wacky family adventures together. But thankfully it’s brought two of the fan favorites from the TV series into the fold with a new sneak peek clip showing off Susan (Alanna Ubach) and Matty (Scott Grimes). You can check it out in action below.

When Does Ted: The Animated Series Come Out?

Ted: The Animated Series will be making its debut with Peacock on Thursday, December 17th with eight episodes all available at once. Additional episodes of the animated series planned for a release sometime in 2027, but no concrete release date has been announced as of this time. The series is set 12 years after the events of the Ted films, and brings back its core cast with Seth MacFarlane as Ted, Mark Wahlberg as John, Amanda Seyfried as Sam, and Jessica Barth as Tami-Lynn. Kyle Mooney and Liz Richman join the cast as Apollo and Ruth, new additions to their families.

Ted: The Animated Series thankfully incorporates two of the big fan favorite changes to the Ted universe seen with the Ted TV series. Alanna Ubach and Scott Grimes’ versions of John’s parents are completely different than seen in the film franchise, and luckily they will be making their return to the franchise with this animated series despite it taking place within the universe of the films. But there’s still a glaring absence from Giorgia Whigham’s Blaire through the promotional materials so far.

What Does This Mean for Ted Season 3?

For those fans of the Ted TV series, the humor of this new animated version seems to be more in line with it. That’s also helped by the fact that Ted: The Animated Series is created Seth MacFarlane, Paul Corrigan and Brad Walsh, who were also showrunners of the live-action series. It seems that while a third season of the live-action series might not be in the cards for the moment as it’s been deemed too “expensive” for Peacock , the team has found a creative way to keep things going.

Ted: The Animated Series might not be the kind of continuation that fans of the Peacock series might have been hoping to see , but with Matty and Susan returning for the new adventures to blend with the movie’s cast that’s going to make it all the more appealing to see how the team is able to work together both worlds. But how are you feeling about Ted: The Animated Series so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: At 25:00, in Akasaka Gets Anime
content:
At 25:00, in Akasaka boys’ love manga by Hiroko Natsuno is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and trailer have also been unveiled and the main cast will reprise their roles from the drama CDs, with Soma Saito voicing Yuki Shirasaki and Takuya Sato voicing Asami Hayama. The anime premieres in 2027.

Comments from the cast have also been released:

Yuki Shirasaki – Voice Actor: Soma Saito First and foremost, congratulations on the anime adaptation!My name is Soma Saito, and I will be voicing Yuki Shirasaki.I first encountered the original manga when I was cast in the dramaCD. I vividly remember being captivated first by the beauty of thecharacters’ eyes, and then by the story and its characters. I becamecompletely engrossed in reading it. I’m truly delighted to have theopportunity to be involved once again as a cast member in a work thatmeans so much to me. I’ll give it my all.I look forward to working on this project!

Asami Hayama – Voice Actor: Takuya Sato Congratulations on the anime adaptation of “At 25:00, in Akasaka”I’m delighted to be returning as the voice of Asami Hayama, continuingfrom the drama CDs.Rather than simply reminiscing about the time I’ve spent bringing thesecharacters to life alongside Soma Saito, who voices Yuki Shirasaki, I’mlooking forward to meeting Shirasaki’s eyes again with a fresh andgenuine sense of excitement when we begin recording.I’m excited to see how Hiroko Natsuno-sensei’s delicate and intricateworld will be brought to life through animation. I hope you’ll lookforward to it!

Currently serialized in Shodensha’s onBLUE, the original manga has achieved over 2 million copies in circulation, including digital editions. The series also won two awards at the BL Award 2023, taking home both Best Series and Best BL CD. Aside from manga, the title has expanded into drama CDs, merchandise, and collaboration cafés. In 2024, a live action-drama series adaptation aired.

Synopsis: Yuki Shirasaki (26), a newcomer actor, is set to star in a romantic drama about a relationship between twomen alongside Asami Hayama (28), a hugely popular actor who was also his upperclassman at university.Struggling to convincingly portray a gay character, Shirasaki visits a gay bar in search of someone who canhelp him understand the role. However, for some reason, he ends up getting caught up with Hayama, andthe two enter into a relationship as lovers… all for the sake of their acting. Their secret relationship, all for the sake of their roles, begins as filming gets underway! Source: Press Release ©︎Hiroko Natsuno, SHODENSHA/ ”At25:00inAkasaka” Production Committee
